description.value:
Range touch

Targets you or 1 willing creature

End one condition the target is suffering that was inflicted by a Choir's Toll result — the sickened of Sympathetic Fever, the drained of Cold Spot, or any condition a future Toll result imposes. This cannot undo a Toll result that was an event rather than a condition: a Verse that already fizzled stays spent, an Afflicted that already collapsed stays gone, and a creature the Choir already recruited is not given back.
